svg.text: Exactly three things: the on/off switch (on by default), the always-captured standard set (read-only) and custom commands with a regex — plus the hook-version line.
Where Claude went on the network in each session of this repository — shown on the session’s Network tab.
Applies from the next session. Log Hub’s own uploads are never recorded.
Off: runtime capture stops; records found in the transcript are still shown.
Runtime capture needs hook 2.xx — 1 of 4 hooks in this repo is older.
Which one and how to update ›
Reference only. Recognised whenever the switch above is on — typed by Claude or run inside a script Claude ran.
Your own tools that reach the network. Recognised in the command text only (not wrapped).
✗ Not a valid regex: missing “)”. Fix it to save.
Try it: — (no test until the regex is valid)
No match → the call is still recorded, with “destination unknown”.
Regex up to 200 characters, checked on save, run with a time limit.
A new repository Settings tab next to Monitored Tools. It holds exactly three
things: the switch, the standard set (read-only) and custom commands.
Off: runtime capture stops for every hook of this repository from the next
session; records found in the transcript are still shown. A developer can also
switch it off on their own machine (local kill switch).
Runtime capture (command results, Node and Python scripts) needs hook 2.xx.
Counts the hooks seen in this repo; older ones keep sending transcript-only
Grouped, read-only list with a lock: no toggles, no delete. It explains what the
Network tab can see; it is not a preset the user applies.
Name + regex whose first group is the address. Text only, never wrapped: no exit
The test field runs the regex as you type; the result shows the extracted
address in green with ✓, or “no match → destination unknown”.
The regex field turns red, the reason is shown under it, the test is paused and
Save is disabled. The server validates again on save.
Never an error at run time
A command that does not match is still recorded, with “destination unknown”.
Regex length is limited and it runs with a time limit.
